message: this text changed since the last publish and its clip audioPath did not, so the clip may no longer match the text. This check compares with the published copy; it cannot tell a clip that was already stale at publish.

fix.note: No tool generates audio for a plan field: generate_lesson_audio and server/audio.js work on legacy worksheet.js lessons only. Remove the stale clip path (replace_part without it) so the old clip stops playing, or put a new .mp3 under the audio folder and set its path.
